title: The Diplomatic Correspondence of Thomas Bodley, 1585-1597
author: Thomas Bodley
institution: Centre for Editing Lives and Letters (UCL), with the Bodleian Library; editor Robyn Adams
notes: Letters to and from Thomas Bodley during his diplomatic career, with customisable transcripts (abbreviations expanded or shown, as the reader chooses). Texts: 990 XML letter files in the project's GitHub repository (1585-1597). Words are not given because the XML mixes abbreviation and expansion markup so a reliable word count was not possible. The XML uses the project's own markup, not TEI; the repository was last pushed in 2013 but the site pages show 2025 modification dates, so it is treated as still online and maintained.
